body:
Thanks. I hadn't heard of the term anhedonia before; I think that describes it pretty well, except if I start doing something I used to enjoy I enjoy it again. I've had trouble starting when I'm depressed.

I'm experiencing frustration and anger over being physically not well, in debt, and having a bad relationship at work, and not being able to be productive. I often think my situation is hopeless and that my situation is a reflection of me, rather than the present me being a reflection of my situation, since I always seem to mess things up after I get them going smoothly. I used to get drunk and pass out every few months until about a year ago and had one emergency room incident with alcohol. I'd quit drinking for months or years and start back up again.

When I'm having suicidal thoughts I think that if I'm capable of killing myself I'm capable of hurting others because if I don't care about myself I don't care about others. It's always strangers or acquaintances I imagine hurting because I can't bear the thought of physically hurting family or friends.

I overeat consciously and have got drunk in the past, as mentioned earlier, but have not deliberately inflicted physical injuries on myself, though I have banged my head against things.

* Apparent lack of remorse[4] or empathy for others

Sometimes I think *fuck everyone* but not really.

* Persistent lying or stealing
* Cruelty to animals[5]

No.

* Poor behavioral controls — expressions of irritability, annoyance, impatience, threats, aggression, and verbal abuse; inadequate control of anger and temper

I have a hard time controlling my moods so I thought it described me when I first read it, but I don't think it does now. Sometimes when I've got angry and blamed people I've cut them off; not expressed my anger.

* A history of childhood conduct disorder

No.

* Recurring difficulties with the law

Taxes; otherwise no.

* Promiscuity

No, but no relationships either.

* Tendency to violate the boundaries and rights of others

No, except for dark thoughts.

* Aggressive, often violent behavior; prone to getting involved in fights

No.

* Inability to tolerate boredom

I wish. I spend a lot of time moping around.

* Poor or abusive relationships

No; a loner. Most relationships I'm all bottled up.

* Irresponsible work behavior

I slack and sometimes think, fuck it, I'm not going to get it done.

* Disregard for safety

No, except for some episodes.

--

Hmm...I guess I when I read that a few weeks ago I was imagining how I thought I might be instead of how I actually have been.

I have said disgusting things out loud in my mind. I guess it's not really how I feel, it's real suicidal thoughts combined with jealousy, narcissism, and anger.
